sentences.text: Learned advocate for the applicant has submitted that the only role attributed to the present applicant in commission of the offence is to the effect that the bank account of the present applicant had been used for deposit of the amount of fruad at Level-4.
Except this, no other overt act has been attributed to the present applicant.
He, therefore, submitted to allow the present aplication and enlarge the present applicant on bail subject to suitable conditions.

4. Learned APP for the respondent-State has opposed the present application, inter alia, contending that the ban account of the present applicant had been used for deposit of proceeds of fraud and the amount of Rs.4,96,000/- had been received in the account of the present applicant, which had been subsequently withdrawn by him and had been given to the other co-accused.

She, therefore,
submitted to dismiss the present application.

5. As per the case of prosecution, the accused including the present applicant had formed Whats'
app group in the name and style of Saxo Bharat Exchange and the first informant and other victims were added to the said group and they were told that if they invest their money in the stock market as per the advice of accused, they would earn handsome return on the said investments and accordingly, the first informant and other victims had transferred the amount of Rs.86 lacs to various accounts as informed by the accused.
Out of the aforesaid amount, the amount of Rs.4,96,980/- have been received in the bank account of the present applicant.

The record indicates that the applicant had allowed his bank account to be used for the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/5157/2025 ORDER DATED: 12/03/2025 undefined purpose of deposit of proceeds of fraud and had received some commission for the said purpose.

The record also indicates that another offence of similar nature has been registered against the present applicant, which indicates that the applicant appears to be habitual in commission of similar nature of offences.
Having regard to the same, no case is made out to release the present applicant on bail.
Hence, the present application stands dismissed.
(M. R. MENGDEY,J) GIRISH Arvindsinh S/O.
